intent.summary: Provides a viewport over content whose resolved extent may exceed available space.
useWhen: Content must remain reachable when larger than its viewport
avoidWhen: All content must participate in the parent extent without independent scrolling

semantics.childPolicy: one logical content subtree; multiple children require an explicit grouping container
semantics.sizing: viewport is parent-constrained; content may exceed enabled axes
semantics.ordering: content order is unchanged by scrolling

attributes.name: axes
attributes.description: Axes on which content may scroll.

attributes.name: indicatorPolicy
attributes.description: Visibility policy for scroll position indicators.

attributes.name: initialOffset
attributes.description: Initial logical offset on the primary axis.

accessibility.nameSource: nearby label or application-defined name when needed
accessibility.focusBehavior: viewport participates in keyboard scrolling; focusable descendants remain reachable
notes: Focus movement must reveal the focused descendant.

mappings.strategy: Preserve axes, indicator policy, and content subtree.
Map enabled axes and scrollbar visibility directly.
caveats: Nested scrolling requires explicit chaining policy.
